question: Which industry raises the most support tickets per customer?

{"type": "answer_plan", "interpretation": "Answer to: Which industry raises the most support tickets per customer?", "sql": "SELECT c.industry,
       COUNT(t.ticket_id) * 1.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT c.customer_id) AS tickets_per_customer
FROM customers c
LEFT JOIN support_tickets t ON t.customer_id = c.customer_id
GROUP BY c.industry
ORDER BY tickets_per_customer DESC"}
